lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust is dancing on the cracked clay floor
The rain forgot to knock upon my door
I'm tracing shadows in the fading light
Just a weary soul in the middle of the night
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind is whispering a heavy tune
Underneath the ghost of a fading moon
[Chorus]
Heavy road and a heart of stone
Walking this valley all on my own
The sky is grey and the fields are dry
Watching the clouds roll slowly by
[Verse]
My boots are worn from the miles I've tread
With a thousand words left to be said
The horizon stretches like a ribbon of gold
A story of patience waiting to unfold
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind is whispering a heavy tune
Underneath the ghost of a falling moon
[Chorus]
Heavy road and a heart of stone
Walking this valley all on my own
The sky is grey and the fields are dry
Watching the clouds roll slowly by
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The ground is parched and crying out
The shadows stretch as the day grows stout
[Chorus]
Heavy road and a heart of stone
Walking this valley all on my own
The sky is grey and the fields are dry
Watching the clouds roll slowly by
[Outro]
